definitions.explanation: Work assigned by a teacher to be done outside of class. A fundamental part of Japanese education.
Can also refer to something left undone that needs to be addressed, like 'homework' from a meeting or project.

examples.japanese: {宿題|しゅくだい}はもう{終|お}わりましたか。
examples.english: Have you finished your homework already?

examples.japanese: {宿題|しゅくだい}を{忘|わす}れてしまいました。
{毎日|まいにち}{宿題|しゅくだい}がたくさんあります。
examples.english: There's a lot of homework every day.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}は{夏休|なつやす}みの{宿題|しゅくだい}を{出|だ}しました。
examples.english: The teacher assigned summer vacation homework.

examples.japanese: {宿題|しゅくだい}が{終|お}わったら、{友達|ともだち}と{遊|あそ}んでもいいです。
examples.english: Once you finish your homework, you may play with your friends.

examples.japanese: それは{今後|こんご}の{宿題|しゅくだい}ですね。
examples.english: That's something to work on going forward.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}は{私|わたし}たちの{宿題|しゅくだい}です。{来週|らいしゅう}までに{答|こた}えを{出|だ}しましょう。
examples.english: This issue is something we need to address. Let's come up with an answer by next week.

examples.japanese: {宿題|しゅくだい}をやらなかったので、{先生|せんせい}に{怒|おこ}られた。
examples.english: I was scolded by the teacher because I didn't do my homework.

examples.japanese: その{件|けん}は{宿題|しゅくだい}として{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}ります。
examples.english: I'll take that matter back as something to work on.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{宿題|しゅくだい}がまだ{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: There are still pending tasks from the meeting.

notes: {宿題|しゅくだい}をする means 'to do homework'. Japanese schools typically assign homework even during summer vacation ({夏休|なつやす}みの{宿題|しゅくだい}). The kanji {宿|しゅく} means 'lodging/home' and {題|だい} means 'topic/problem'.
